en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a central European square with a large equestrian statue on a monumental pedestal, surrounded by several standing figures at its base. Behind it are ornate late‑19th‑century buildings with domed roofs, and on the left edge part of a large Gothic church façade is visible. A tall streetlamp stands near the statue. The image is framed in an oval on a plain background. At the bottom in Hungarian are printed captions indicating the location and identifying the statue of King Matthias.
